skill_issues.what: It lists cards judged on an earlier day as undecided, including cards accepted and built yesterday, because decided_local reads only the current day ledger.
skill_issues.evidence: --undecided on bp-temper today listed 47 cards including DW-36, DW-43, DW-107 (built 2026-11-05); the launch message had to warn about it.
skill_issues.fix: Read every day ledger for the decided_* fields, or add the verdict date and let --undecided skip any card with a verdict that is not a deferred:cap snooze due today.

skill_issues.what: A deferred:cap snooze can say real while the card's own falsifier was never run, so the note reads as a checked verdict and the next day may accept on it.
skill_issues.evidence: The 2026-11-05 note on DW-159 says real with a probe on generated buffers; its falsifier asks about real captures. Today noise-probe.mjs over 22 real pairs found 6 lamp-sway boxes under the line, and the card was rejected.
skill_issues.fix: Have the carried note state the falsifier result (checked, how; or open), and have triage check warn on a carried verdict that does not.

skill_issues.what: No state fits a repo with visible UI changes and no persona driver: skipped reads as nothing to walk, and not-reachable claims no surface reaches it, while a dev server would.
skill_issues.evidence: This cycle changed Cards.tsx, Lamp.tsx, Engine toasts; runner.md step 4 says UAT in another repo is the test lanes.

skill_issues.what: One QA subagent writing all specs before any build leaves the day branch red on npm run check for the whole build, with a landable-looking history: a land of a prefix would ship red specs.
skill_issues.evidence: qa/report.json reds_at_head: 144 of 152 passed at 2da43f6, 8 gates red, until the fix commits.

skill_issues.where: runner block, cycle_file and scratch naming
skill_issues.what: Cycle numbers restart each day and the paths carry no date, so yesterday's cycle-2-bp.json and cycle-2-bp.end.json sit at the very paths today's runner writes, and c2/ may hold old files.
skill_issues.evidence: ls ~/.temper/runs on 2026-11-06 shows cycle-2-bp.json, cycle-2-bp.end.json from 2026-11-05 before this cycle wrote anything.
skill_issues.fix: Put the date in the runs path (~/.temper/runs/<date>/c<n>/), or have cycle begin archive the old day.
